basic_details.job_title: NBCC India Expert Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC India) has officially announced the Expert (Horticulture and Landscaping) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening under Advertisement No. 02/2026. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.nbccindia.in/. Candidates who are not more than 65 years of age and hold a Bachelor's Degree in Botany, Agriculture, or Horticulture along with an M.Sc. or Post-Graduate Diploma/Degree in Environment and Ecology, Landscape Architecture, or Agriculture are eligible to apply. Interested candidates can submit their application

qualification.details: Retired officers having minimum Bachelor's Degree in Botany/Agriculture/Horticulture from a Government recognized University/Institution OR MSc or Post-Graduation diploma/Degree in Environment and Ecology / Landscape architecture or in Agriculture from recognized University/Institute. Should have retired from E-3 Level or above.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NBCC India Expert (Horticulture and Landscaping) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBCC India Expert (Horticulture and Landscaping) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 04 August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Botany/Agriculture/Horticulture or an MSc or Post-Graduation diploma/Degree in Environment and Ecology / Landscape architecture or in Agriculture from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Expert (Horticulture and Landscaping) position is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Expert post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 72,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Expert post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve two stages: Shortlisting of applications followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC India).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 02/2026.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete bio-data and required documents before the last date.
